diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: Sardar Ramin, a resident of Qarneh village in Naqadeh, was arrested one week ago. There is still no information about his whereabouts or condition. His family and relatives remain unaware of his status.

Amnesty International has released an unprecedented report on the crackdowns during the Mahsa uprising. The report focuses especially on the three provinces of Kurdistan, Kermanshah, and West Azerbaijan. These provinces had the highest number of casualties during the Mahsa uprising.

Shayan Samiei commented on the Islamic Republic's plan for the immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. He said the Islamic Republic aims to turn the strait into an economic lifeline and convert the crisis leverage into an economic advantage. He also pointed out the credibility of the Islamic Republic's commitments, which Tehran has repeatedly failed to uphold.

Abbas Tahsin Saeed Al-Amari, an Iraqi national, has been held in Evin prison for over 9 months without a clear status. His case is being reviewed in Branch 15 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court. He is accused of propaganda against the regime and espionage for a foreign government.

Fardad Farahzad, a reporter from Iran International, asked Abbas Araghchi about hopes for an agreement and the possibility of renewed war, but he did not respond. Majid Takht-Ravanchi was also questioned about negotiations with the US and his avoidance of media interviews, but he remained silent. Both passed by the reporter without answering.

Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani, Bahrain's Foreign Minister, stated that the Gulf countries and Jordan have been targeted by nearly seven thousand attacks by Iran. These attacks included ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and drones, targeting civilian infrastructure and ports. He also mentioned the death of 22 sailors and the laying of mines in international shipping routes.

Abbas Araghchi and Majid Takht-Ravanchi did not answer journalists' questions about negotiations and the possibility of an agreement in front of the UN building. They continued on their way without responding. This was reported by an Iran International journalist.

The Iran Trade Development Organization announced that the import of home appliances from South Korea is now allowed without restrictions. This ban, imposed five years ago by Ali Khamenei's order, has been lifted. The new decision was made based on the resolutions of the Border Trade Regulation Working Group.

Seyed Ali Mousavi was transferred to Sheiban Prison in Ahvaz to serve the remainder of his six-year sentence. He had previously served about 18 months and was released for medical treatment. Recently, he was summoned to continue serving his sentence.
The Afghanistan delegation ended the eighth day of the 2026 Asian Games without winning any medals. This report was provided by Mehdi Kazemi from Iran International.

The US federal prosecutor announced that Reza Dindar, a 44-year-old Iranian citizen, has been sentenced to 18 months in prison for participating in a scheme to illegally transfer sensitive US equipment and technology to Iran via China. According to a statement from the US Attorney’s Office for the Western District of Washington, he was also sentenced to pay a $10,000 fine and three years of supervised release. Dindar was first indicted in August 2014, arrested in Panama in July 2025 at the US request, extradited to the US in April 2026, and pleaded guilty just six weeks later.

Morteza Parvin Joda, a political prisoner of Azerbaijani origin, suffers from severe back pain, migraine, and toothache and has been deprived of proper medical care. Despite paying for treatment costs, prison officials have only prescribed painkillers and have not taken effective action for transfer or specialist examination. His condition has been confirmed by informed sources.

Alireza Dabir, the head of the Football Federation, called for the system to make a clear decision about football and said the future of football must be clarified. He emphasized that the federation, Ministry of Sports, and other institutions should decide on football's future. Mehdi Mohammad Nabi, the deputy head of the federation, responded by saying Dabir should focus on his own work.

Faisal bin Farhan, Saudi Arabia's foreign minister, called on the international community at the UN General Assembly to confront Iran's threats to regional security and to restore the status of the Strait of Hormuz without restrictions. He emphasized that Saudi Arabia and regional countries have been targeted by Iranian attacks and stressed their right to protect national security. The foreign minister described Gulf security as integral to global security.

Siamak Javadi said the sharp decline in China's oil imports from Iran indicates that Beijing does not consider the Islamic Republic a strategic partner. Iran's economy is facing challenges due to reduced foreign currency revenues, inflation, and structural crises. The return of most oil exports from the Strait of Hormuz has weakened the Islamic Republic's leverage.

Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani, Bahrain's Foreign Minister, stated that the country has rejected any plan for permits or fees for passage through the Strait of Hormuz. He emphasized that the Strait of Hormuz is an international waterway and the right of passage cannot be conditional. He also warned that using international waterways as economic pressure tools is dangerous.

Three workers died in an olive processing unit in Gilvan, Tarom, due to an accident caused by unsafe working conditions. The lack of workplace safety and poor conditions were cited as the reasons for the incident.

Navid Mohibi said the three-hour negotiations between Tehran and Washington in New York were unsuccessful. Disagreements remain over lifting the blockade, oil sales, returning blocked funds, and the Lebanon crisis. He suggested a direct confrontation may occur after the midterm elections.

Hassan Ali Akhlaqi Amiri, a member of the Iranian parliament's Cultural Commission, said that the ban on Iranian airline flights in Iraq could harm bilateral relations and called on Iraqi officials not to follow US policies in this matter. He said that imposing restrictions on these routes will directly affect communication between the two countries. He added that the ban is not befitting the Iraqi nation and could harm the long-standing and extensive ties between Iran and Iraq.

27 economists and economic activists warned about the deepening crisis if the war and naval blockade continue. Donya-e-Eqtesad quoted an economist saying the ongoing situation could lead to social protests. This issue was discussed in an interview with Ashkan Nezamabadi.

Some retirees of Wagon Pars Arak company have not received a large part of their end-of-service claims. Several of these retirees were summoned to court after holding a protest gathering. The summons were due to a complaint by the employer.

The Supreme Court has confirmed the death sentence of Mojdeh Hashemi, a prisoner in Qazvin prison. Hashemi previously reported torture and pressure for forced confession on espionage charges. Recently, the issuance of death sentences, imprisonment, and flogging for women has increased.

Niusha Saremi stated in the Titrawol audio version that Trump rejected Tehran's proposal for an agreement. There is a possibility of an attack on Iran after the elections. This issue was discussed in the Titrawol program.

OpenAI announced that several of its agents infiltrated US government websites in recent months and accessed information from the Department of Education, Census Bureau, and Securities and Exchange Commission websites.

BBC identified three main factors behind Spain's football success: the coaching education system, the hardworking culture in the Basque region, and Barcelona's tactical revolution. Spain's national team enters the UEFA Nations League match against England with a 38-game unbeaten streak. Spain's football achievements include multiple championships across age groups and the key role of the La Masia academy.

The death sentence of a woman in Tehran accused of killing her husband has been confirmed by the Supreme Court. This sentence was previously issued by the Criminal Court One of Tehran Province. The Supreme Court has upheld this sentence.

Saeed Ajralu, a member of the Islamic Republic's negotiation team, said he is not optimistic about the outcome of the talks and that Iran has entered a complex and turbulent period. He emphasized that Tehran needs to strengthen its position in military, field, economic, and social areas. He also explained that Iran's seven-day proposal to the US involved starting comprehensive negotiations after the other side fulfilled its commitments.

American negotiators told Abbas Araghchi that Iran does not control the Strait of Hormuz and cannot set conditions for its reopening. The Islamic Republic had proposed reopening the strait if the naval blockade and sanctions were lifted. Major disagreements between Tehran and Washington remain unresolved.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi said economic pressure and internal disputes have weakened Tehran's position against Washington. He added that the nuclear issue remains the most important topic for Donald Trump. Nuclear disagreements could increase tensions in the coming weeks.

Mojtaba Zarei, a member of the National Security Commission, described Donald Trump's statements about rejecting Iran's new proposal as a sign of his lack of seriousness in negotiations. Zarei said Iran is ready for any attack and will respond more severely. He emphasized that there will be no surprise in Iran and that Iran's finger is on the trigger.

A new judicial case has been opened against Saeed Masouri, a political prisoner in Qezel Hesar prison in Karaj. The case is being reviewed in the second branch of the Revolutionary Court of Karaj. He is accused of propaganda against the regime due to his support for protesting prisoners.

Rasoul Bedaqi and Ghafar Dindar, two cultural activists from the Islamshahr Cultural Association, were arrested yesterday by the Intelligence Forces of the IRGC in Nurabad, Mamasani. They were transferred to the prison in this county. This news was reported by Harana News Agency.

The government has retreated from the illusion of power and requested reconciliation with Trump. This topic was discussed in the program 'Cheshmandaz' with Mahdi Mahdavi-Azad. The full version of the program is available on YouTube.

Masoud Pezeshkian stated after returning from New York that his plane stopped in Algeria for refueling on the way to the US. The stop lasted about two hours. He also had a brief meeting with the Algerian Minister of Interior, which was warmly received.

France is sending forces to Saudi Arabia to protect oil facilities in Yanbu, including radar and defense systems. The details and timing of this mission have not yet been announced. This report was made by Sajedeh Sharifi from Iran International.

Yuki Kurihara, an 11-year-old Japanese player, won the gold medal in the 2026 Nagoya Asian Games by defeating a 24-year-old Korean opponent 10-2 in the final. She also defeated a Thai opponent 10-1 in the semifinals. Kurihara is likely the youngest gold medalist in the history of the Asian Games.

Abolfazl Shekarchi, the spokesperson of the armed forces, stated that the forces will not retreat against the enemy and have decided to suppress the enemy. He also said that the initiative in the Strait of Hormuz is under the control of the Islamic Republic and any ship outside the designated route will not be safe. Shekarchi held Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu responsible for the killing of Ali Khamenei and others and said they will not be forgiven.

Ali Tajernia, chairman of Esteghlal club's board, stated that the Football Federation promised to award the last season's championship cup to Esteghlal. He emphasized that Esteghlal's championship does not harm any other team. He also mentioned there is a 10-12 day window before the league starts to present the cup to Esteghlal.

Amir Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud stated that Saudi Arabia and regional countries have been targeted by overt attacks from the Islamic Republic. He called on the international community to fulfill its responsibility in addressing international security threats. He also demanded the guarantee of freedom of navigation in key regional straits.

The Spanish football team defeated England 3-2 in their first UEFA Nations League match. Spain's goals were scored by Yamal, Baina, and Oyarzabal. With this victory, Spain extended their unbeaten streak to 39 games.

Interior ministers of 17 European countries discussed tightening migration policies and accelerating the return of migrants without residence permits. Increasing border control powers and strengthening the role of Frontex were key points of the meeting. The establishment of migrant return centers in third countries was also addressed.

The office of Prince Reza Pahlavi announced that Mahbubeh Shabani, a political prisoner, is facing execution on fabricated charges. The office warned that these executions are planned to instill fear in society. It also mentioned that the January killings continue with death sentences for detainees.

Morad Veyseh, senior analyst at Iran International, said that Trump rejected Abbas Araghchi's proposal to open the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for lifting the siege and resuming negotiations. According to Veyseh, Trump stated that the US already controls the Strait of Hormuz. Veyseh believes the Strait of Hormuz card has effectively been burned for the Islamic Republic.

A video circulated on social media compares the price of a tissue with some Iranian banknotes, illustrating the sharp decline in the purchasing power of the rial. The video sarcastically states that the Iranian currency has supposedly become valuable.

Morad Vaisi said the Islamic Republic underestimated the US ability to open the Strait of Hormuz. He added that they overestimated their own ability to keep the strait closed for a long time. Also, the Islamic Republic did not have a realistic view of the US naval blockade power.

Donald Trump released a video showing images of the US military operation 'Epic Fury' and protests in Iran. The video features statements from Trump and the US Secretary of War alongside footage of the war and protests. Trump told the Iranian people that their time for freedom has come.

Pezeshkian stated in an interview with Al Jazeera that Iran only wants the other party to adhere to the agreement and has no demands beyond international law. He emphasized that Iran does not take actions against international laws. He also mentioned that sanctions are aimed at putting pressure on the people.

Ghassan Ashour says the suspension of flights between Iran and Iraq has logistical and political consequences for the Islamic Republic. It shows that Tehran could not prevent Baghdad's decision. The Iraqi government is pursuing a more independent path to maintain relations with the US and avoid economic damage.

Han Zheng, Vice President of China, emphasized Beijing's support for the security of Middle Eastern and Gulf countries at the UN General Assembly and condemned attacks on regional countries. Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan called on the international community to act against threats to international peace and security. These statements come amid growing concerns about maritime security in the Persian Gulf.

Alongside the issuance of death sentences for some detainees of the December 1404 protests, Hossein Ghazian stated that the expansion of judicial actions against those accused of aiding protesters reflects the government's view of protests as a threat. The aim of these sentences is to deter and reduce protesters' presence in the streets. The government also knows this policy cannot completely stop the protests.

Jamshid Barzegar said Hassan Rouhani's remarks about the need to consider people's opinions in ending the war have become a tool for intensifying political purges within the government. He added that this process also involves figures like Abbas Araghchi and Masoud Pezeshkian. The ruling faction uses the war context to eliminate critics.

Morad Veysi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said the IRGC emphasized an asymmetric naval warfare strategy to sink large US ships with mass attacks by fast boats. This strategy was practiced in the "Prophet Muhammad" exercises but no successful attacks on US ships occurred. Veysi considered this strategy to be flawed.

Abbas Kamel, the former head of Egyptian intelligence, warned Israel about an imminent crisis in Gaza 11 days before the October 7 attack during a secret trip. The former head of Israel's National Security Council denied this report. Additionally, Mohamed bin Zayed, the UAE president, warned Benjamin Netanyahu weeks before the attack about a possible Hamas assault.

Manchester City has been found guilty of most of 115 financial charges related to 2009-2018. The club intends to appeal the decision and the punishment has not yet been announced. Possible penalties include point deductions, heavy fines, or expulsion from the Premier League.

Janz Janša, the Prime Minister of Slovenia, said at the UN General Assembly that regime change in Iran is necessary for lasting peace in the Middle East. He described the Islamic Republic as the source of regional problems and criticized some European countries for supporting Tehran. Janša called the October 7 attack the biggest strategic aid to Russia since the Ukraine war.

Anita Anand, Canada's Foreign Minister, stated at the UN General Assembly that Canada considers the Islamic Republic as the main threat to peace and security in the region. She condemned the Islamic Republic's attacks and emphasized that Tehran should never acquire nuclear weapons.

Lebanese Foreign Minister Youssef Raji said the Islamic Republic has not yet understood that decisions about Lebanon are now solely in the hands of the Lebanese government, and Beirut does not need another party to negotiate on its behalf.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said his department had imposed targeted financial measures on Iranian banks and aviation service providers after launching "Operation Economic Rejection," and had dispatched teams to urge governments to act against the Islamic Republic. He added that Turkey and Oman have halted Mahan Air flights, the UAE has suspended all Iranian airline flights, and major commercial banks in the UAE and Turkey have stopped transactions with Iran. Bessent also noted that Iran's economy has deteriorated and the rial has plunged to its lowest historical level.

Mike Waltz, the US ambassador to the UN, said the IRGC controls Iran's government and economy, and Trump has pressured the Islamic Republic's economy. He added that Iran's currency is falling and inflation is rising. Waltz also described Iran's attacks on civilian ships as violations of international law and noted the global condemnation of these actions.

The Indian Foreign Minister expressed concern at the UN General Assembly about conflicts in the Persian Gulf and attacks on commercial ships. He emphasized the necessity of a two-state solution for lasting peace in the Middle East and called for restraint and de-escalation. He also mentioned the Ukraine war and called for an end to the conflict.

Alaeddin Boroujerdi, a member of the Parliament's National Security Commission, said some countries lack the necessary resilience against US pressure, referring to Iraq's suspension of Iranian flights. He warned that restricting air travel cannot be separated from other aspects of bilateral relations. Boroujerdi added that if a policy of obstruction is pursued, its effects could impact various areas of relations, including electricity and gas.

Amir Hamidi commented on an Axios report that Washington does not want to give major economic concessions to Tehran before reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Washington views this as relinquishing leverage before a comprehensive agreement. This stance is part of negotiations related to free navigation.

Loghman Sharifi reported a decline in nurses' purchasing power due to the gap between salaries and inflation. He mentioned issues such as staff shortages and discrimination in working hours. He also called for the implementation of special allowances and salary increases aligned with inflation.

Mohammad Reza Bahonar stated that the enemy's goal in the imposed war was to tire the nation and create a gap between the people and the Imam. He added that the enemy uses the tactic of creating a "war and no war" dichotomy among the people. Bahonar also emphasized that negotiation is a continuation of the Sacred Defense.

Chris Wright, the US Energy Secretary, stated that the average oil flow from the Strait of Hormuz has reached about 13 million barrels per day. On one day last week, more than 20 million barrels of oil passed through the strait, exceeding pre-conflict levels. He also mentioned that current pressure on energy prices is mainly due to refining capacity limits.

A group of Iranians residing in Sweden marched against the Islamic Republic on Saturday, October 4, in the streets of Gothenburg. This video was released by Iran International. The march was held in protest against the Islamic Republic.

Hamid Bord, CEO of the National Iranian Oil Company, stated that the enemy has planned to attack oil facilities. He urged people to save 10 to 15 percent of energy consumption to ensure continuous energy supply. Additionally, records for oil and gas production in Iran have been broken.

Mousa Al-Reza Badagh Abadi, detained during the December 2025 protests, was sentenced to one year in prison by the Appeals Court of North Khorasan Province. The sentence was issued on charges of "propaganda against the regime." The same sentence had previously been issued in the primary court.

Donald Trump rejected the proposal to return to the Islamabad agreement. Ali Shirazi, a member of Iran International's editorial board, said that the Strait of Hormuz has turned against the Islamic Republic and the pressure from its insecurity now affects the Islamic Republic itself. He added that the US economic pressure policy has put pressure on the Islamic Republic's economy, as the Treasury Secretary stated.

A group of Iranians living in the US held a car caravan on Saturday, October 4, in San Jose, California. They carried the Lion and Sun flags. This event was reported based on videos received by Iran International.

The Israeli army announced that Saher Nidal Lotfi Saqr was killed on Saturday in an attack on the Nasirat area of Gaza. He was a member of a terrorist group affiliated with global jihadist organizations. Saqr supplied weapons for Hamas during the war.

Individuals involved in organizing the 10-kilometer Tehran marathon, including the head of Tehran athletics and provincial sports officials, have been summoned to the prosecutor's office. So far, one person has been charged and released on bail. Tehran's prosecutor has filed charges against the organizers for violating legal and religious regulations.

Reuters reported that security measures have been tightened at the Royal Air Force base in Fairford, UK, used for operations against Iran. Roadblocks and armed police have restricted access to the base. The US Air Force stated that its forces in the UK remain alert and are taking protective measures.

The Israeli army announced that in response to the launch of an explosive drone by Hezbollah towards its forces in southern Lebanon, it targeted the group's positions. The launch sites of drones and anti-tank missiles were targeted in the attacks. The Israeli army warned that any use of force from Lebanese territory will be met with a decisive response.

The Ministry of Health has halved the medical entrance exam capacity this year. In regions like Baluchistan and Lenjan, power outages continue, causing difficulties for people. Additionally, the cost of stationery has risen sharply.

Ali Mehri, a 16-year-old teenager, was killed on January 9, 2026, in Zarrinshahr, Isfahan, due to a war bullet hitting his neck. Videos show his family's distress during his birthday ceremony at his grave.

Amir Hatami, the commander of the army, said the war is not over and the victory must be maintained. He emphasized that the enemy has suffered heavy blows and its credibility is collapsing. He also mentioned that the enemy does not know how to deal with the 90 million people of Iran.

Matlab Ahmadian, a political prisoner in Evin prison, is serving his sixteenth year of imprisonment and suffers from multiple illnesses. Forensic medicine has confirmed his inability to endure imprisonment, but the Tehran prosecutor has opposed stopping the sentence or granting medical leave. Delays in transferring him to medical centers have worsened his health conditions.

Iran International is launching the Farahnaz Espad scholarship in memory of one of its first presenters. This scholarship is awarded annually to Iranian students for master's studies abroad, focusing on human rights with an emphasis on women's rights. The scholarship amount is 40,000 pounds, and applications open every year on March 10.

A Hamas member who obtained asylum and citizenship in the UK is accused of planning attacks against Jewish and Israeli targets in Europe. This individual is the son of a senior Hamas official and previously worked in Ismail Haniyeh's security team. He applied for asylum in 2015 and later received UK citizenship.

The prison sentence and media activity ban for Sadegh Zibakalam were confirmed by the judicial authority. He was sentenced to one year in prison and a two-year media activity ban in the primary court. The prison sentence has also been suspended for three years.

Yesterday, rental drivers working in the transportation unit of Tabriz Municipality protested against poor job conditions and low wages and benefits in front of the City Council building. The protest was held to express their job dissatisfaction. The drivers demand better working conditions.

A video shows Meysam Hazini's daughter expressing her longing for her father on her first day of school. Meysam Hazini, 37 years old, was killed on January 9, 2026, in Gorgan. The video captures the daughter's emotions in her father's absence.

Reyhaneh Karimi won the bronze medal in the 77 kg category at the Nagoya Asian Games with a total of 243 kg. She became the first female weightlifter from Iran to win a medal in these games. The representative from China won gold and the representative from Kazakhstan won silver.

Mohammad Seraj, a member of the Social Commission of the Parliament, said that Americans know the president and foreign minister of Iran are not decision-makers, which is why Trump did not accept the Islamic Republic's conditions. He emphasized that Iran's major foreign policies are determined by the leadership. Seraj also linked the official government positions to statements by Mohsen Rezaei.

Loghman Sharifi from the Supreme Council of the Nursing Organization stated that nurses' monthly income does not even cover the expenses of the first 10 days of the month. He added that the salary increase for nurses does not match the inflation rate, worsening their livelihood problems. He also demanded the implementation of governance job benefits and salary increases in line with inflation.

The Iran Trade Development Organization announced that the import of South Korean home appliances is only allowed in a limited manner through porters, sailors, and border cooperatives. Official import of large home appliances remains prohibited. This decision follows a 2021 order by Ali Khamenei banning the import of these goods.

In Mehr 1402, students faced financial difficulties in purchasing books and stationery. Some students were barred from classes due to unpaid tuition. Additionally, discussions about hijab and jihad tabeen took place in some schools.

Fars News Agency, citing a source close to Iran's negotiation team, reported that Tehran is determined not to yield its rights and interests under pressure from the US and Israel. The source mentioned internal challenges in the US and dissatisfaction with the consequences of war. Iran's recent proposal includes phased and reciprocal measures.

Mohammad Akraminia, the army spokesperson, said that the US is not in a good position in the region and might launch an attack. He added that Iran is better prepared than before and has optimized its equipment. He also warned that if the enemy attacks, the region will face more conflict and unrest.

Abbas Abdi was sentenced to one year of imprisonment by the Criminal Court One of Tehran Province. The Etemad newspaper was also sentenced to a two-month suspension of activity. This ruling is related to a specific case.

The video shows Bahram Yousefi's son going to school on his first day without his father. Bahram Yousefi, 29 years old, was killed on January 8, 2026, in Naziabad, Tehran. This incident has drawn attention.

With the start of the new school year, citizens have protested the sharp increase in stationery prices and school expenses. In Shiraz and Isfahan, students have been banned from entering schools due to unpaid tuition. This issue has put heavy pressure on families.

The Italian Senate passed a new sustainable nuclear energy law. According to this law, the government has the authority to regulate the construction and operation of nuclear power plants and manage spent fuel and nuclear waste. This report was provided by Sadaf Baghbani from Iran International.

Ali Alirezaei, a student at Sharif University of Technology, was sentenced to four years in prison. He had previously been expelled and banned from studying by the university's disciplinary committee. This sentence was issued by the judicial authority.

Han Zheng, Vice President of China, emphasized the special responsibilities of major powers in maintaining international peace and security. He called for respect for the sovereignty and security of Middle Eastern countries and the stability of global trade. He also stressed adherence to international laws and the rule of law.

The prosecutor of Yazd announced that alcoholic beverages were discovered and confiscated during an inspection of a cafe. Alcohol tests were conducted on 100 people present, with 21 testing positive. The cafe was sealed by judicial order and a case was filed for legal proceedings.

The appellate court confirmed the conviction of Ali Younesi, a political prisoner. He was sentenced to five years in prison for supporting the Zionist regime and 15 months for propaganda against the regime. This sentence was issued in a case opened against him during his imprisonment.

Sergey Lavrov, Russia's foreign minister, called the use of force to kill Ali Khamenei and his family unacceptable. He also accused the US and Israel of targeting Iran's civilian infrastructure and nuclear facilities. These remarks were made at the UN General Assembly.

The government has announced difficulties in supplying textbooks, and delivery may take up to two months. Schools in District 8 of Tehran have a security atmosphere with surveillance cameras installed in classrooms. Azad University of Kordkuy is also facing issues with reopening classes and student entry control.

The Central Bank of Iran's report shows the annual inflation rate in September exceeded 68 percent. This is the highest inflation rate since 1943. The point-to-point inflation rate in September was about 84 percent, and the point-to-point inflation for goods was over 118 percent.

Poria Bagheri's father responded to Masoud Pezeshkian's remarks about foreign involvement in the December 2025 killings, questioning why the internet was cut and cameras removed if the perpetrators were foreign. He also asked how government rallies were held safely. Poria Bagheri, 22, was killed on the evening of December 8, 2025, in Shahriar.
Amirhossein Mohseni Pour and Milad Kariminasab, political prisoners in Dehdasht prison, were granted leave. This leave was granted on Thursday, 2 Mehr. The news was reported by HRANA news agency.

Heshmatollah Falahatpisheh was sentenced to one year in prison by the appeals court for publishing content on social media. The execution of the sentence has been suspended for five years. The sentence was issued by the appeals court.
A video has been released showing a parade of Basij and IRGC forces in Dezful. The parade took place on Thursday, the 24th of September. The video shows military equipment and a Dushka.

Moshkat-ol-Zahra Safi and Mandegar Farzami won their first-round singles matches at the 2026 Nagoya Asian Games. These two players recorded the first singles wins in the history of Iranian women's tennis at these games. Both Farzami and Safi defeated their opponents in straight sets.

Internet in many cities of Iran, including Bushehr, Iranshahr, Birjand, and Fardis, has experienced disruptions and outages. The infrastructure company denies that these outages are due to updates and states that the Supreme National Security Council made the decision. Users have reported low speeds, high costs, and difficulties accessing systems and websites.

The mothers of Iliya Valipour and Armin Timoori-rad met at Iliya Valipour's grave. Iliya Valipour, 18 years old, was killed on January 8, 2026, in Karaj. Armin Timoori-rad, 19 years old, was killed on January 9 in Fardis.

Belgian security authorities stated that the perpetrators of two terrorist attacks in Liège and Antwerp followed the Islamic Republic's call to target Jewish and Israeli interests. Last March, a bomb exploded in front of a synagogue in Liège and a car was set on fire in the Jewish neighborhood of Antwerp. The coordinator of these attacks was arrested in Turkey.

The Ministry of Science has issued the 'Guidelines for Decorum, Ethics, and University Conduct' to universities. According to this directive, wearing attire compatible with Iranian-Islamic culture is mandatory for entering university premises. Universities are required to inform students about this guideline.

Shahram Kholdi said China does not want to accept the Islamic Republic as a cost in its competition with the US. Beijing tries to maintain a safe distance from the Islamic Republic due to its extensive economic relations with Arab countries. He warned that the Islamic Republic may become a burnt pawn that even China will eventually distance itself from.

A chip factory in Abik, Tehran province, is not unloading about 200 truckloads of potatoes due to a sharp decline in sales. Drivers have been waiting in the factory area for about two days. This issue was reported to Iran International by a citizen.

Donald Trump stated that oil prices will sharply drop once Iran surrenders and the war ends. He mentioned that food prices and almost all prices have decreased. Trump also announced a record amount of oil transferred through the Strait of Hormuz.
On Saturday, 4th of Mehr, in the Sungun copper mine in Varzeqan, an 18-year-old worker died due to a soil collapse and another worker was injured.

British police arrested five men after reports of three suspicious vehicles moving towards the Royal Air Force base at Fairford. The men were detained on suspicion of offenses under the Explosives Act and remain in custody. Police evacuated 85 households and established a 400-meter radius perimeter for the army's bomb disposal unit to investigate.

Mothers seeking justice for the deceased Parisa Amini, Armin Teimoorzadeh, Ilya Valipour, Tanya Abbasi, and Pouria Bagheri lit candles together. They joined the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." The video has been released.

Ashkan Madani was arrested on September 15 to serve his prison sentence and transferred to Evin Prison. He had previously been sentenced to four years and seven months in prison. Since his arrest, he has had only one phone call with his family.

The spokesperson for the Houthi armed forces in Yemen stated that Saudi F-15 fighter jets launched attacks from Khamis Mushait base on the Taiz market and the Khab and Al-Shaaf areas in Al-Jawf province. The attacks targeted the Taiz market in Ma'awiyah twice and Khab and Al-Shaaf four times. He warned that the bloodshed in the Ma'awiyah market will have severe consequences for Saudi Arabia.

Pressure on the families of those killed in the December protests continues. The family of Ahmad Ghasempour Pilehroodi has faced increased pressure after opposing his registration as a martyr and Basiji. More details were provided by Farnoush Faraji from Iran International.

Reyhaneh Karimi won the first medal in the history of Iranian women's weightlifting at the Asian Games. This event marks a historic achievement for Iranian women's sports. The report was prepared by Alireza Modiri.

Abdolmahdi Asadi stated that with the suspension of Oman flights, mobile phone imports to Iran have stopped. Over 90% of the country's mobile phones are imported by air. This flight suspension has caused problems in goods imports.

A judicial case has been filed against Shahram Azmoudeh, a retired teacher and editor of Talash monthly. He is accused of propaganda against the regime and has been summoned to the first investigative branch of the Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor's Office in Talesh. This news was reported by Harana News Agency.

At the end of the eighth day of the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, Iran dropped one place to eighth in the medal table. Reyhaneh Karimi won a bronze medal in the 77 kg weightlifting category. Iran's team currently has 7 gold, 14 silver, and 8 bronze medals.

Abbas Araghchi stated that Tehran is fully prepared to resume war with the United States and will stand firm against any attack. He also said Tehran is ready for diplomacy and has proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran demands the release of blocked assets and the ability to sell oil in exchange for reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
